rights: 1955 translation by Ortega y Medina (d. 1992); not established as public domain or openly licensed. Publisher-hosted historical journal scan. Short quotation subject to independent review of jurisdiction, purpose and extent, and source and translator attribution.
method: Maker inspected journal p.9 and compared the surrounding paragraph with German Ueber die tragische Kunst at Wikisource. The Spanish article uses a thematic title, but its preceding and following sentences match the surrounding argument of the original; its opening omits original viertens and Handlung is rendered narración. Second reader must independently verify source and alignment.

III p164.text: La tragedia, empero, tiene una intención poética; a saber, ella presenta una narración con objeto de conmover y por medio de la emoción deleitar.

research_notes.source_identity: The journal uses the thematic heading La Verdad Poética y la Verdad Histórica. Its preceding and following sentences correspond to Ueber die tragische Kunst: https://de.wikisource.org/wiki/Ueber_die_tragische_Kunst . Opening ordinal viertens is omitted in this excerpt; the selected III p164 sentence is present.
